answer: Each identity binds one government-issued residence permit: its number hash and authority signature enter the Copper Registry on a 35 POA bond locked 120 days. The bond doubles per extra permit from one cluster, capped at 1,120 POA from the sixth, so 100 fakes lock 107,485 POA plus 15,000 POA in broker fees doubling every 50 sold. A per-epoch zephyr check re-attests validity within 72 hours; two misses halve the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs, a duplicate slashes both bonds, and the Beacon Index caps each office at 40 permits per epoch. Citizens pass on a passport plus a doubled bond.
